item.title: Green GSM Enters Northern Mindanao
item.description: Green GSM has officially launched its all-electric taxi service in Northern Mindanao following a trial operation that began in late August. The company introduced the service on September 29 in El Salvador, Misamis Oriental, with its VinFast electric taxi fleet now available in Cagayan de Oro, Lagui

item.title: EastWest widens mobility aid
item.description: EastWest has donated vehicles to Our Lady of Guadalupe Minor Seminary and Jubilee Christian Academy as it expands its EasyMobility for Community Program to support more educational and nonprofit institutions nationwide. The latest donations follow earlier vehicle turnovers to organizations in Cebu,
